You ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world. A Day in the Life The Global Operations and Supply Chain Value stream is accountable for the plan, build and run activities for all applications from the Global Operations and Supply Chain stakeholders. Seeking an experienced EDI Integration Specialist with strong expertise in enterprise EDI middleware applications (e.g., WebMethods/Trading Network, BizLink/BizManager) and EDI standards such as ANSI X-12 and xCBL. The role requires proficiency in SAP SD, Pricing, and EDI within SAP ECC and S/4 HANA environments, as well as experience working with third-party EDI service providers (Value Added Networks). The ideal candidate will have the ability to translate business processes into technical requirements, manage multiple priorities, and deliver solutions on time and within budget. Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills are essential, along with excellent communication and collaboration abilities. A solid understanding of business processes, transactional systems, and data-driven enterprise IT applications is required. This position demands a goal-oriented, business-focused professional who can work independently and as part of a global team, ensuring productivity, profitability, and continuous process improvement. Responsibilities may include following and other duties may be assigned: Ability to translate business processes or concepts into technical requirements and vice versa. Ability to manage multiple complex priorities. Strong decision-making abilities and problem resolution skills. Excellent teamwork skills. Strong interpersonal, oral, presentation, and written communication skills. Ability to understand end-audience needs and requirements. Strong understanding of business processes and vocabulary. Analytical problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and efficiently prioritize tasks. Ability to work collaboratively within a team and across teams. Required Knowledge and Experience: Experience with enterprise EDI middleware applications. E.g. WebMethods/Trading Network, BizLink/BizManager. Experience with EDI standards. ANSI X-12, xCBL. Experience with SAP SD, Pricing and EDI (SAP ECC and S/4 HANA) Experience with third-party EDI service providers. (Value Added Networks) Experience in business process definition, requirements definition and technology solution research. Experience with transactional and data driven enterprise IT applications Goal oriented, task driven decision-making with a strong sense of accountability. Focused on improving productivity, profitability, and business processes, delivering solutions on time and within budget. Business focused, boundary less team member with global scope and ability to translate business requirements into IT deliverables.
